body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles), Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Finding in PR #1216, exact merge `d13250b2e7adb0f7fca00e8ee37acda4dc5cb490`, head `63dd8b283d521833a7cc01a61eb29f21fab0d559`.

The documented source-overlay reproducer provides only `--run-id run-one` or `run-two`. Both destinations are already retained in the merged packet. It creates those directories with `exist_ok=True` and calls `Path.write_bytes` on all three existing evidence files without an exclusive/no-overwrite guard. The README says derived output paths are new files, but the supported CLI offers no fresh destination. A later rerun can replace the archived geometries, ledger and summary instead of preserving the original vintage; a changed runtime/code/source outcome can replace old evidence before another check detects the difference.

Actual evidence: I executed the unchanged complete producer twice from its immutable merge, intercepting only its final filesystem writes and redirecting them to exclusive fresh Auditor files. The original script reached all six write calls targeting the three **existing** files in each original run. The existing-destination condition was not rejected. No original file was actually overwritten by this test. Both fresh runs reproduce the original data exactly: selected-components 274,326 bytes / SHA256 `271d213f985d3a9f22d28f244d04b6a9a5dbe70ae9bbe925c5dcc50bda818379`; overlay-ledger 1,157,441 bytes / SHA256 `d653653d1aa4517c4542d532b8a659d9dfd11ce1da049e48684bd73482c7f61c`; summary 1,400 bytes / SHA256 `e940b3ef4844115bd53c885a7fc6a1cfb9ceee1fce745a00c1fc9be6cbf2fd13`. The issue is preservation behavior, not incorrect current overlay numbers.

Reproduction (inspect in an isolated scratch review; do not overwrite originals): run the unchanged `reproduce-source-overlays.py --run-id run-one` with a boundary that records/refuses writes to retained files. It attempts writes to `results/run-one/selected-components.geojson`, `source-overlay-ledger.json`, and `source-overlay-summary.json`. Without that protective test boundary, the unguarded `write_bytes` calls truncate/replace existing originals. `--run-id auditor-new` is rejected by argparse choices, so there is no supported fresh-vintage route. The same behavior applies to run-two.

Expected/success criteria:

- Add a corrected reproducer only in the new owned `reproduction-erratum/` directory. Read the original packet as immutable inputs, retain all original source/capture/control/output bytes, and accept a genuinely fresh named output vintage with exclusive creation and validated resolved containment. Do not patch or regenerate the original packet files.
- Exercise actual CLI rejection for existing files/directories and symlink/traversing/outside destinations before any original mutation. Keep sentinels/whole-file original hashes unchanged. Show two complete fresh output families with explicit immutable producer/helper/transitive-code pins and whole encoded/decoded inputs; identical corresponding payloads and explicitly accounted truthful vintage/path metadata. Compare against preserved originals without silently replacing them.
- Retain exact all-year 282-component roster (`37b5efeb08f407cd19cc098186659a01899d748d8dd73b3c26bfccbd1d35fc66`), all 283 fragment bindings, 571 source contacts, full/simplified administrative products and separate RESOLVE inputs. Carry all four exact subjects and complete 82 frozen baseline inputs plus the source/output/code descriptors from the original manifest with their truthful commits. Read every actual whole file; do not substitute an unchecked manifest hash. Preserve all unknown classifications and unresolved source/registration/causal limits.
- Retain failed attempts and original controls, run meaningful changed-input/omitted-scope/vintage/preservation controls, use the existing byte limits, and obtain distinct exact-head source/implementation review plus normal CI/queue. One focused source-only PR; no physical cause, wetness, owner or geography approval inferred from successful reproduction.

Scope/overlap: original #1205 is closed and its canonical author claim is released. The complete open/closed issue and open PR inventories contain no correction for this producer. #1218/#1227 concern the coastal #1160 packet and own different paths; they cannot repair this Matanuska producer. Existing #486/#601/#605 and current global #1184 work remain read-only context. This correction owns only the safe nested `reproduction-erratum/` subdirectory; it must not acquire the enclosing campaign. Independent source-authentication gaps in the ongoing Auditor review are separate and are not resolved by this output-preservation fix.

Readiness initially blocked pending the new shared read-only readiness check and fresh final overlap/dependency/ownership readback. No implementation reservation is taken by the Auditor. Resume condition: complete mechanical preflight and reviewed disjoint scope/dependency evidence; no scientific approval implied.
